value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper explicitly raises classification of standard maximal measurable frames, and exhibits nonmeasurable six-voter examples without an exact census. The result settles the complete six-voter layer with a sharp four-instance logical obstruction and a uniform small integer representation certificate, useful for finite model checking and constructive consistency of majority logic. This is an intrinsically natural complete finite stratum, not an arbitrarily chosen parameter slice.
